enabled.description: Whether to enable the ISATAP daemon at boot.

interface.description: Network interface to bind to for ISATAP traffic.

isatap_router_ipv4.description: IPv4 address of the ISATAP router (must be set for proper operation).

isatap_ipv6_prefix.description: IPv6 prefix used to construct ISATAP interface identifiers (e.g., 2001:db8:1::/64).

mtu_discovery.description: Enable RFC 4861-style MTU discovery for ISATAP.

trusted_hosts.description: List of additional trusted ISATAP host IPv4 addresses (beyond the configured router).

items.description: IPv4 address of a trusted ISATAP host.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (DEBUG, INFO, NOTICE, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

log_file.description: Path to log file, or '-' to log to stdout.

ipv6_forwarding.description: Enable system-wide IPv6 forwarding (required for ISATAP router role).

zones.description: List of ISATAP zones (used for multi-domain deployments).

router.description: IPv4 address of the zone's ISATAP router.
